exposure: Planned mode of birth after caesarean section
cohort: 31,131 women with one or more previous caesarean sections who gave birth to a term singleton in Scotland between 2010 and 2015 with no prior psychotropic medications in the year before birth
finding: Women giving birth by ERCS were more likely than those having a planned VBAC to be dispensed psychotropic medication including antidepressants in the first year postpartum.
mod_finding: Women planning a VBAC were less likely to be dispensed psychotropic medication, including antidepressants, than women planning an ERCS.
